artworks.title: Le bal pare
artworks.artist: Antoine-Jean Duclos after Augustin de Saint-Aubin
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an elaborate ballroom scene. The image depicts an opulent interior with finely detailed walls adorned with classical motifs and large draped windows. Several grand chandeliers hang from the ornate ceiling, illuminating the room with soft candlelight. The floor is filled with elaborately dressed figures, all wearing period clothing that suggests an 18th-century setting. The central figures are engaged in a dance. surrounding them are onlookers seated or standing, talking amongst themselves or watching the dancers. The scene conveys an air of elegance and refinement, reflecting the social activities and formal gatherings of the time.

artworks.title: Le concert
artworks.artist: Antoine-Jean Duclos after Augustin de Saint-Aubin
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a grand salon setting with elegantly dressed figures. The detailed interior scene shows an ornately decorated room with drapery-covered windows, elaborate wall moldings, and strategically placed busts and statues. A group of individuals in period attire is seen conversing or admiring a central activity, possibly involving music, as suggested by the presence of musical instruments and music sheets. Intricate details fill the room, capturing an opulent social gathering from the 18th century. The style is classical with attention to textures, patterns, and architectural elements like the ceiling fresco and columned walls.

artworks.title: Le concert
artworks.artist: Antoine-Jean Duclos after Augustin de Saint-Aubin
artworks.description: The image shows a grand salon scene with a large gathering of people in 18th-century attire. Men and women are seated and standing in an ornate room with high ceilings, decorative moldings, large windows, and a checkered floor. Columns, pilasters, paintings and architectural details adorn the walls.

artworks.title: Le concert
artworks.artist: Antoine-Jean Duclos after Augustin de Saint-Aubin

artworks.title: The First Come Best Served
artworks.artist: Antoine-François Sergent after Augustin de Saint-Aubin
artworks.medium: etching and wash manner printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated on a bed, with disheveled sheets. Her body is turned to the side as she looks down towards her chest, resting her head against her hand. She wears a long, light-colored dress with loose sleeves. There are a few indistinct figures lying down around her, and a small cat sits by her feet. In the foreground, a man in a hat peeks into the scene from an open door, looking surprised. The background shows a shadowy room with drapery around the bed. The lighting emphasizes the soft, intimate atmosphere of the setting. Below the scene, the words "The first Come first served" are inscribed.

artworks.title: The Place to the First Occupier
artworks.artist: Antoine-François Sergent after Augustin de Saint-Aubin
artworks.medium: etching and wash manner printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene within a rustic setting. The image shows a cluttered room with various objects scattered around. In the lower section of the circle, figures are depicted sitting or reclining among objects like wooden boards, a basket, ropes, and textiles. Details in the room include everyday objects such as a bottle, hats, shoes, and a sketching board leaning against a chair. The light source appears indirect, casting soft shadows and highlighting the textures of draped fabrics. A window on the left shows an outdoor view framed by a lattice pattern. A central focus is created by the circle format of the drawing, emphasizing the cozy yet chaotic environment. A ceiling beam in the upper part of the drawing is adorned with what could be a small animal resting or sleeping. The setting conveys casual disarray and intimacy.

artworks.title: La promenade des remparts de Paris
artworks.artist: Pierre-Francois Courtois after Augustin de Saint-Aubin
artworks.description: The image shows an outdoor social scene viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is low, with the tops of trees and a row of buildings in the distance. The visual elements include elegantly dressed figures engaged in various activities like walking, conversing, or attending to children. The brushstrokes, done using an etching technique, are detailed and precise, capturing the attire and tree textures. The color palette is a monochromatic sepia tone, giving a timeless quality to the scene. Trees on both sides frame the gathering, creating depth and leading the eye towards the more distant architecture where more people can be seen.

artworks.title: Ballet at the Opera
artworks.artist: Pierre-François Basan after Gabriel Jacques de Saint-Aubin
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of a gathering of elegantly dressed figures in an outdoor setting. The horizon line is high in the image, obscured by trees. The detailed line work and cross-hatching give texture and depth. The color palette is monochromatic, using black and white. Closest to us, a group of individuals in opulent attire are engaging in conversation or dance. In the background, trees arch overhead, blending into the lush surroundings.

artworks.title: La Comparison du bouton de rose
artworks.artist: Antoine Francois Dennel after Gabriel Jacques de Saint-Aubin
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated on a bed, with her upper body and legs visible. She is holding a mirror in her right hand and a small object in her left hand. She is wearing a light-colored bonnet and a loose, flowing dress. The setting includes rich, textured drapery.

artworks.title: It's Too Late (Il est trop tard)
artworks.artist: Antoine-François Sergent
artworks.medium: color etching and wash manner on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features figures in a rustic interior setting. A boy in white shirt and blue shorts climbs a wooden ladder. A girl in white top and striped skirt sits on hay, with an older woman in white headscarf and pink skirt assisting her. In the background, a man in knee-length trousers and a hat enters through an arched opening, carrying a stick. Various rustic objects are scattered around, with the bright sky visible outside.

artworks.title: Marie-Thérèse-Charlotte, Duchess of Angoulême
artworks.artist: Christian von Mechel after Antoine-François Sergent
artworks.description: The image shows a woman's upper body portrait. She is facing the viewer with slightly turned position. She has large eyes, a small nose, and a subtle expression with a beauty mark above her lip. She has curly, shoulder-length brown hair partially covered by a sheer black veil. She wears a dark high-collared dress with lace trim at the neckline and a purple sash around her waist. The background is a uniform dark oval framed within a border, and below the portrait, there is text identifying her as Marie-Thérèse-Charlotte, daughter of King Louis XVI. The image is within a rectangular frame with additional writing below the main portrait.

artworks.title: Caffeé des Patriotes - A Patriot's Coffée House
artworks.artist: Jean-Baptiste Morret after Jacques-François-Joseph Swebach-Desfontaines
artworks.medium: color etching and wash manner, printed in blue, red, yellow, and black inks, on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (outer framing line): 28.1 x 54 cm (11 1/16 x 21 1/4 in.)
plate: 41.3 x 61.8 cm (16 1/4 x 24 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a painting of the interior of a coffee house. The scene shows a crowded space with people engaging in various activities like conversation and reading. The room is lit by a large window, with simple decorative elements on the ceiling. The individuals are dressed in period attire from the 18th or early 19th century, with details like tricorn hats and knee-length coats. The setting reflects a social atmosphere typical of coffee houses known for being social and intellectual hubs. This painting is in the style of Thomas Rowlandson.

artworks.title: Le danger des bosquets
artworks.artist: Pierre Adrien Le Beau after Nicolas Tanché
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a woman seated, with one arm resting on a surface. She has an elaborate 18th-century hairstyle, a composed expression, and wears a formal gown with lace and ribbon embellishments. The background depicts trees and foliage. The image is framed with floral motifs and decorative elements.

artworks.title: Le desirs naissants
artworks.artist: Pierre Adrien Le Beau after Nicolas Tanché
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated in an ornate oval frame decorated with floral and foliage designs. She is reclining in a chair with her head resting on her hand. The woman has delicate facial features, closed eyes, finely defined eyebrows, and an elegant hairstyle with an ornate hat. She wears a decorated gown with a lace collar, bows, and floral accents, and holds a string of pearls or beads. Next to her is a birdcage on a small table. In the background, there are drapes, a window showing foliage outside, and ornate decorative elements framing the composition.

artworks.title: Noce de Village (Village Wedding)
artworks.artist: Charles-Melchior Descourtis after Nicolas Antoine Taunay
artworks.medium: color etching and wash-manner engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
sheet: 39.7 × 29.3 cm (15 5/8 × 11 9/16 in.)
overall (outer framing line): 32.1 × 34.5 cm (12 5/8 × 13 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a painting of a scene at a fair or gathering beneath a large canopy or tent. Various containers and barrels are present, adding to the rustic feel of the setting. Wooden structures and ropes suggest a temporary and utilitarian setup. Wisps of smoke or haze are visible in the atmosphere. The characters are dressed in period attire indicative of an 18th-century setting, with women's dresses and men's coats and hats. The style is reminiscent of Jean-Baptiste Joseph Pater, known for his depictions of festive gatherings and outdoor scenes.

artworks.title: Foire de Village
artworks.artist: Charles-Melchior Descourtis after Nicolas Antoine Taunay
artworks.description: The image depicts an outdoor scene from what appears to be an 18th-century setting. The point of view is from a slight elevation, showing a crowd gathered for a performance on a small stage to the right. The stage is surrounded by tall trees with lush foliage blending into the sky. The horizon is not visible, as the scene is enclosed by the foliage and stage. The brushstrokes are fine and detailed, capturing intricate textures of trees, clothing, and facial expressions of the figures. The color palette is muted and earthy, with shades of green dominating the landscape, contrasted by warmer tones of people's attire. Closest to us, two dogs stand on the grass, while a child holds a woman's hand slightly left of center. Further in the distance, behind the crowd, tents are pitched, indicating a temporary festive setting.

artworks.title: L'invocation a l'amour
artworks.artist: Carl Guttenberg after Etienne Theaulon
artworks.description: The image displays a woman wearing a flowing gown, standing on her toes and reaching towards a statue of a winged child or cherub. She has one arm outstretched to touch the statue, while her other arm rests on the pedestal. Her head is tilted upwards, and her long hair flows down her back. The woman is surrounded by a garden setting, with foliage in the background and another small figure partially visible behind a hedge or ornament.

artworks.title: Frederica Sophia Wilhelmina of Prussia, Princess of Orange Nassau
artworks.artist: Charles-Melchior Descourtis after Friedrich Tischbein
artworks.medium: color etching and wash-manner engraving on wove paper
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing the upper body of a woman, including her head, shoulders, and chest. She is positioned facing slightly to her right, with her head turned toward the viewer. Her facial features include a fair complexion, light-colored eyes, and a neutral expression. She has voluminous, powdered hair styled in an 18th-century fashion, with elaborate curls and two long braids over her shoulders, adorned with a decorative black band. She is wearing a sheer, delicate gown with a high, ruffled neckline, and a prominent pink sash draped over her right shoulder. Around her neck is a brooch-like adornment beneath the ruffles. The background is plain with a dark oval framing the portrait, providing contrast against the paleness of the paper surrounding it.

artworks.title: Le dejeuner de Fanfan
artworks.artist: Jean-Baptiste Mallet after Henri Nicolas van Gorp
artworks.description: This is a painting featuring a woman, a nurse, and a child in an elegantly decorated interior. The room includes a woman, a nurse holding a child, a fireplace, a canopy bed, a portrait on the wall, a mantel, a bust, a cabinet, a table with a tea service, and parquet flooring. The style resembles François Boucher's work.

artworks.title: La statue du dieu Pan (Statue of the God Pan)
artworks.artist: after Henri Nicolas van Gorp
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals in a garden setting. The man on the left wears a blue coat, breeches, and stockings. The woman in the center wears a large feathered hat and a soft-colored dress. The woman on the right wears a red dress and a flowery bonnet. The background features a large tree, dense foliage, a stone balustrade, and a partially visible statue. The atmosphere is serene.

artworks.title: La Belle Jardinière - Madame de Pompadour
artworks.artist: Jean-Louis Anselin after Carle Van Loo
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body view of a person positioned slightly at an angle, looking towards the viewer. The person's facial features are detailed, with a composed expression and prominent eyes. They have styled hair covered with a large hat with a wide brim. They wear elegant attire, a flowing garment tied with ribbons at the shoulders, and additional fabric gathering around their torso. In their left hand, they hold a cluster of flowers, and draped on their forearm is a beaded necklace. The background features a natural setting with dense foliage and cloudy skies, suggesting an outdoor scene.

artworks.title: La Belle Jardinière - Madame de Pompadour
artworks.artist: Jean-Louis Anselin after Carle Van Loo
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of a woman from the waist up. She is seated in a relaxed posture, slightly angled to the side, looking directly at the viewer with a composed expression. She has an oval face, soft eyes, and a subtle smile. Her hair is styled in an elegant updo, and she wears a large, broad-brimmed hat. The woman is dressed in a flowing garment with ruffles and bows at the shoulders. She holds a bouquet of flowers in one hand, with additional flowers and a rope basket in her lap. She wears an earring and a ribbon around her neck. The background shows foliage, implying an outdoor setting, creating a serene and refined atmosphere.

artworks.title: Louis-Auguste, Dauphin de France
artworks.artist: Louis-Marin Bonnet after Louis Michel Van Loo
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man from the waist up in an oval frame. He is facing the viewer with a slight turn to his right. He has a youthful face with fair complexion, slightly arched eyebrows, and a small smile. His hair is styled in a powdered fashion with curls and tied at the back. He wears a red coat, a blue sash over his right shoulder, and a white cravat. The frame includes leaf motifs and text below states the subject as Louis Auguste, Dauphin of France. The background is a textured grayish-black pattern.

artworks.title: La soiree du Palais Royal
artworks.artist: Jean Gabriel Caquet after François-André Vincent
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals outdoors. On the left, a seated woman faces her companion. The woman on the left wears a dress and a hat with feathers. The woman next to her wears a dress with ruffles and holds a fan. A man stands nearby, wearing a coat and holding a cane. In the background, there is a garden with a large statue on a pedestal, surrounded by trees and foliage. A small dog is next to the seated women.
